$comment: The license gate (scripts/license-gate.mjs, docs/adr/0040-dependency-license-policy-ci-gate-and-sbom.md) lets a package whose SBOM entry has no SPDX license pass only when an entry here maps that exact name@version to an SPDX expression after a person read its license file. A new version needs a new entry.
